subject: EVS
chapter: Chapter 4: Our School — A Happy Place
central_question: How can students work together to make their school happy, safe, clean, resource-wise, green and respectful for everyone?
in_scope_units: Green School: Aasha and Mohit discuss waste management, water saving, careful electricity use and campus greenery.
Swachh Bharat Swachh Vidyalaya and Activity 1: clean schools, safe drinking water, hygiene and mapping the school campus.
Be a School Explorer: Water Watchers, Electricity Savers, Waste Warriors, Green Guardians and Traffic Trackers observe school conditions.
Waste Management and Activity 2: reduce, reuse, wet and dry waste segregation, recycler items and dignity of labour.
Let Us be Cool and Activity 3: shade, ventilation, white and black surfaces and ways to keep buildings cooler.
Dripping Water and Activity 4: leaks, measurement of water loss, rainwater collection and Jal Shakti Abhiyan.
Greenery Around Us and Activity 5: trees, shade, birds, insects, temperature comparison and butterfly gardens.
Traffic Signs: school-gate observations, traffic rules and a safety signboard.
Fire Safety: fire extinguishers, exit routes, assembly points and safe fire-drill behaviour.
What We do Matters and Activity 6: respect, kindness, inclusion, cleanliness and responsible behaviour.
Let us reflect, Questions 1–9: happiness tree, letters, perspective writing, role-play, speech and a school survey.
banned_topics: Detailed national symbols and currency-note study from Chapter 5.
General forms and sources of energy from Chapter 7.
Weaving, fibres and stitching from Chapter 8.

known_pitfalls.claim: A green school only needs more plants.
known_pitfalls.correction: The chapter includes waste management, water saving, careful electricity use and caring for trees.

known_pitfalls.claim: All waste should be placed in one bin.
known_pitfalls.correction: Activity 2 separates wet waste, dry waste and items for recyclers.

known_pitfalls.claim: A black roof stays cooler because black reflects heat.
known_pitfalls.correction: The chapter says a white roof reflects the Sun’s heat, while a black surface absorbs heat.

known_pitfalls.claim: Students should run during a fire drill.
known_pitfalls.correction: They should move quickly but calmly, not run, and gather at the assembly point.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Activity 1: identify features that belong on a school map.
NCERT Activity 2: classify wet waste, dry waste and recycler items.
NCERT Activity 3: compare black and white surfaces kept in the Sun.
NCERT Activity 4: explain why a dripping tap must be repaired.
NCERT Activity 5: compare water kept under a tree and under the Sun.
NCERT Activity 6: choose respectful action in everyday school situations.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter section is ‘Let us reflect’, Questions 1–9 on pages 71–72.
